instrumented_identities.rule: re-hash the live canary files at rerun start and record the comparison before launching; any mismatch fails setup

run_identity_inventory.rule: the launcher validates every inventory entry (executable, observer/settlement-type, adapter, Brain, launcher/watcher, configuration) at the last setup boundary before spawn; missing/null/mismatched entries abort the launch. Fixture identities are validated from the preflight record; schema version and fixture hashes appear in preflight.json and the RUN-INDEX.

launcher_watcher.ownership_rule: the launcher spawns and reaps the real OMP child, captures pid/exit/timestamps, starts the watcher first and waits for its baseline acknowledgment, and stops and reaps the watcher after exit plus a bounded grace; teardown runs in a finally path for every exit, and success requires watcher health, satisfied expectations and a zero child exit
launcher_watcher.binding_rule: the launcher validates the committed 25-role identity inventory against the actual spawn inputs (its own file, bun, CLI entry, extensions, watcher, python), the environment and argv contracts, the home schema version, the preflight record and the fixture identity at the last boundary before spawn; missing/null/mismatched entries abort with exit 2
launcher_watcher.watcher_rule: read-only (URI mode=ro); state-1/state-2 are classified from the retained backup snapshot itself; a missed intermediate state is reported state_1_missing, never reconstructed
